## What changed

Describe the problem and the observable result of this change.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Relevant Playwright browser tests pass.
- [ ] Runtime size remains within budget, or the change explains the increase.
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect public behavior changes.
- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots are synthetic, licensed or fully redacted.
- [ ] The change preserves local processing, accepted pages, exact-byte checks and resource cleanup.

## Additional evidence

Include relevant measurements, screenshots or reproduction steps. Do not attach private documents.
